description: MacBook Pro 14-inch M1 Pro (j314s, t6000) on mx-mac
source: omarchy-m-test --record against tests/corpus/m1-pro-mx-mac/ (scrubbed). Real evidence from the M1 Pro, 2026-09-12: reviews/pr-9835/m1-hardware.log and m1-validation.md (uname, model, PCI, Hyprland input devices, Wi-Fi address). No kernel log or device-tree dump of the M1 exists yet; the v0.1 dogfood run records them. The package, encryption, first-boot, mac-check, GPU, battery and CPU answers were never captured on the M1: they are reconstructed from what is known of the install (mx-mac, GRUB, linux-asahi) and noted as such.
